  • Methodendetails

    • withDistribution

      A withDistribution(RandomDistribution distribution)
      Set the distribution to use when generating random numerical values.

      jqwik currently offers two built-in distributions:

      • RandomDistribution.biased() is the default
      • RandomDistribution.uniform() creates a uniform probability distribution
      Parameter:
      distribution - The distribution to use when generating random values
      Gibt zurück:
      a random distribution instance
